title: The little man in the model village moves one window a day
description:
I moved to a small town by the sea where nobody talks to me, and took the job repainting the model village on the front. Every house in town is down there, no higher than my knee, with tiny painted people glued in the streets.

One of them isn't glued. He's the size of my thumb, he wears a mustard scarf, and every afternoon he's standing in a different window, one street further up the hill.

It's made up. Built with code and Blender.
